headline: Stocks to Watch Today: Infosys, IndusInd, Coforge in focus
summary: Infosys cuts FY27 guidance as North America demand slows. IndusInd Bank posts strong Q2 profit and plans branch expansion. Coforge raises EBIT margin outlook.

headline: Biocon secures Yesintek market entry in 9 new countries
summary: Biocon signs license with Janssen for Yesintek biosimilar in Australia, Brazil, China, and other key markets. This expands global reach for the Stelara competitor.

headline: Ramky Infrastructure wins ₹588.57 crore EPC contract
summary: Ramky Infrastructure secured a ₹588.57 crore EPC contract from RVNL for housing projects in Chhattisgarh. The company has a market cap of ₹1700 crore.

headline: Ritco Logistics wins contracts worth ₹119.55 crore
summary: Ritco Logistics secured new contracts worth ₹119.55 crore in September 2026, with major orders from BCPL and HRRL, strengthening its logistics order book.

headline: MOSL upgrades BSE to Buy with ₹4,000 target
summary: Motilal Oswal upgrades BSE to Buy with a ₹4,000 target price, citing 85% surge in October MTD notional ADTO vs August and a partial CAS reversal from December 7, 2026 as structural catalysts.

headline: Jefferies maintains Buy on MCX with ₹4,000 target
summary: Jefferies reiterates Buy on MCX with a ₹4,000 target price, noting the 12% share-price decline as an entry point. Energy contributes 60% of transaction revenue versus 40% from bullion.

headline: Citi cuts JSPL target to ₹850, keeps sell rating
summary: Citi maintained a sell rating on JSPL and cut its target price to ₹850 from ₹900. Q2 adjusted EBITDA rose 34% YoY to ₹25bn on 27% volume growth and 12% higher realisations.

headline: JSW Steel Q2 EBITDA up 39% YoY; mixed broker views
summary: JSW Steel's Q2 EBITDA rose 39% YoY to ₹99.4bn, beating estimates by 3%. Citi maintains Sell with ₹1,135 target; Jefferies holds Buy at ₹1,650; CLSA stays Outperform at ₹1,500.

headline: JPMorgan upgrades Dr Reddy's to Neutral, target ₹1,270
summary: JPMorgan upgraded Dr Reddy's to Neutral with a target price of ₹1,270. Q2 revenue missed estimates, but adjusted core margin of 19.5% beat by 160 bps. Semaglutide and abatacept remain uncertain.

headline: HSBC maintains Buy on Dr Reddy's, target ₹1,375
summary: HSBC reiterates Buy rating on Dr Reddy's with a target price of ₹1,375, citing improved Q2 gross margins from branded-segment contribution and US launches.

headline: Torrent Pharma: Brokerages split on Q2 results
summary: Nomura maintains Neutral while Jefferies, Citi, HSBC and Kotak retain Buy ratings. Core India growth of 20% offsets JB Pharma integration delays.

headline: Kotak Bank Q2 PAT in line; CLSA, Bernstein weigh in
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank's Q2 PAT matched estimates after FCNR adjustments. CLSA maintains Outperform with ₹485 target, citing 18% asset growth. Bernstein holds Market Perform at ₹500, noting 29% EPS rise.

headline: HSBC, Bernstein back IndusInd Bank; UBS stays Sell
summary: IndusInd Bank Q2 results see mixed analyst reactions. HSBC and Bernstein maintain Buy/Outperform on asset quality gains, while UBS and Macquarie cite margin pressure.

headline: LTTS signs five-year engineering deal with Nokia
summary: L&T Technology Services secures a five-year contract to support Nokia's R&D in India, establishing a dedicated Offshore Development Center.

headline: 360 ONE, TR Capital eye stake in Hector Beverages
summary: 360 ONE and TR Capital are reportedly in talks to acquire stakes in Hector Beverages, the maker of Paper Boat drinks, valuing the company at ₹2,700–3,000 crore.

headline: French defence firm plans to boost India sourcing
summary: A French defence company plans to increase sourcing from India after procuring €1.2 billion in goods and services over five years, signalling growing business opportunities.

headline: Indian Railways eyes export cargo weighment exemption
summary: Indian Railways plans to exempt containerised export cargo from mandatory 100% weighment, aiming to reduce logistics delays and support export growth.

headline: IRDAI extends feedback deadline to October 31
summary: IRDAI extended its feedback deadline on insurance commission regulations to October 31 after receiving over 650 stakeholder responses flagging revenue, distribution, and employment risks.

headline: Coforge named Leader in Everest Group QE Matrix 2026
summary: Coforge Limited has been recognized as a Leader in the Everest Group Quality Engineering Services for AI Applications and Systems PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026, highlighting its AI-native capabilities.

headline: Onward Technologies Q2FY27 Results: Revenue up 22%
summary: Onward Technologies reported highest ever quarterly revenue of ₹170.2 crore, up 22.4% YoY. EBITDA margin hit all-time high at 15.6%. FY27 revenue guidance raised to 15-18%.

headline: Mukta Agriculture promoter sells 2 lakh shares
summary: Krishan Khadaria, promoter of Mukta Agriculture Limited, sold 2,00,000 equity shares in the open market on October 23, 2026. His stake decreased from 3.30% to 2.37%.

headline: Titan Biotech allots 1.03 crore bonus shares
summary: Titan Biotech Limited allotted 1,03,29,625 bonus equity shares in a 1:4 ratio. The record date was October 23, 2026, increasing paid-up capital to ₹10.33 crore.

headline: Brigade Enterprises to add 600 Hyatt Regency rooms in Bengaluru
summary: Brigade Enterprises Ltd plans two new Hyatt Regency hotels in Bengaluru, adding 600 rooms to its portfolio through management agreements with Hyatt Hotels Corporation.

headline: PTC Industries sees ₹65.97 crore BSE block trade
summary: A block trade of approximately 28,013 shares of PTC Industries was executed on BSE at ₹23,550.00 per share, aggregating to ₹65.97 crore.

headline: ICICI Bank block trade of ₹71.33 crore on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 514,913 shares of ICICI Bank was executed on the NSE at ₹1,385.20 per share, amounting to ₹71.33 crore.
